Pattern: danh từ đếm được; create/a supportive + learning environment
Examples: A quiet learning environment matters more than new equipment. | The redesign created a more supportive learning environment.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; poor/effective + classroom management
Examples: Classroom management is the hardest skill for new teachers. | Effective classroom management prevents most conflict.

Definition: mức độ tham gia của người học
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; boost/measure + student engagement
Examples: Short tasks boost student engagement in long lessons. | Attendance is a crude measure of student engagement.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; uphold/breach + academic integrity
Examples: Every student signs a statement on academic integrity. | Buying an essay is a clear breach of academic integrity.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; move to/rely on + continuous assessment
Examples: Continuous assessment rewards steady work. | The school moved to continuous assessment in 2021.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; rely on/criticise + standardised testing
Examples: Standardised testing allows comparison between schools. | Critics say standardised testing narrows the curriculum.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; top/publish + a league table
Examples: League tables push schools to select easier subjects. | The paper publishes a league table every August.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; live in/fall within + a catchment area
Examples: House prices rise inside a good catchment area. | The family fell just outside the catchment area.

Definition: năm nghỉ giữa phổ thông và đại học
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; take/spend + a gap year
Examples: She took a gap year to work and travel. | A gap year can strengthen a university application.

Pattern: study abroad (không có giới từ); dùng được như tính từ: a study abroad programme
Examples: More graduates choose to study abroad for a master's. | He studied abroad for one semester.

Definition: chuyến đi thực tế, thực địa
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; go on/organise + a field trip
Examples: The geography class went on a field trip to the delta. | Field trips cost money many families do not have.

Definition: ngày mở cửa tham quan trường
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; hold/attend + an open day
Examples: The university holds an open day each September. | We attended three open days before deciding.

Definition: công tác hỗ trợ tinh thần cho học sinh
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; provide/strengthen + pastoral care
Examples: Pastoral care keeps vulnerable pupils in school. | The school strengthened pastoral care after the inspection.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; offer/seek + careers advice
Examples: Good careers advice prevents expensive mistakes. | Few pupils receive careers advice before choosing subjects.

Definition: đời sống và sức khoẻ sinh viên
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; look after/a student welfare + officer
Examples: A welfare officer looks after student welfare on campus. | Student welfare was ignored during the expansion.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; cope with/reduce + exam pressure
Examples: Exam pressure peaks in the final two months. | Teaching revision skills reduces exam pressure.

Definition: lớp có nhiều trình độ khác nhau
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; teach/differentiate in + a mixed-ability class
Examples: Teaching a mixed-ability class demands careful planning. | In a mixed-ability class the fastest pupils finish early.

Pattern: sit + N (exam, test); dạng Mỹ dùng take an exam
Examples: Candidates sit the exam in three separate sessions. | He sat the same exam twice.

Pattern: set + N (homework, a task, a deadline)
Examples: Teachers set homework twice a week. | She sets a short reading task every Friday.

Pattern: mark + N; dạng Mỹ dùng grade
Examples: It takes an hour to mark an essay properly. | He marked thirty essays over the weekend.

Definition: dạy hết nội dung chương trình
Pattern: cover + N (syllabus, material, ground)
Examples: We cover the syllabus by the end of April. | Rushing to cover the syllabus leaves gaps.

Pattern: hit the books (không đổi hình thức)
Examples: I need to hit the books before the final exam. | She hit the books as soon as the dates were announced.

Definition: làm quen dần với công việc
Pattern: learn the ropes (thường ở thì tiếp diễn hoặc hoàn thành)
Examples: New teachers spend a term learning the ropes. | He has already learnt the ropes in the laboratory.

Definition: đỗ với kết quả xuất sắc
Pattern: pass + N + with flying colours
Examples: She passed with flying colours in all four papers. | All four candidates passed with flying colours.

Definition: giai đoạn phải học rất nhiều trong thời gian ngắn
Pattern: have/face + a steep learning curve
Examples: The first month was a steep learning curve. | Anyone switching field faces a steep learning curve.

Pattern: learn + N + by heart
Examples: We had to learn twenty lines of poetry by heart. | Learning formulas by heart is no substitute for understanding.

Pattern: know + N + inside out
Examples: She knows the syllabus inside out. | After ten years he knows the subject inside out.

Pattern: play truant (Anh); play hooky (Mỹ)
Examples: A handful of pupils played truant all term. | He was caught playing truant twice.

Definition: thức khuya học hoặc làm việc
Pattern: burn the midnight oil (không có tân ngữ)
Examples: Students burn the midnight oil in the final week. | She burnt the midnight oil to finish the dissertation.

Definition: tư duy thoát khỏi lối mòn
Pattern: think outside the box (không có tân ngữ)
Examples: The task rewards students who think outside the box. | Examiners welcome candidates who think outside the box.

Pattern: give/provide + sb + food for thought
Examples: The lecture gave us plenty of food for thought. | Her final question was real food for thought.

Definition: đưa lí thuyết vào thực hành
Pattern: put + N + into practice
Examples: Placements let trainees put theory into practice. | The workshop puts the reading into practice.

Definition: hiểu và nhất trí với nhau
Pattern: be on the same page (as + sb)
Examples: The teacher checks that everyone is on the same page. | Parents and staff are now on the same page.

Pattern: do/take + a crash course in + N
Examples: He took a crash course in statistics before the project. | A crash course in referencing would save them hours.

Definition: từ đầu, từ con số không
Pattern: learn/start + sth + from scratch
Examples: She learnt Mandarin from scratch in two years. | The department rebuilt the course from scratch.

Pattern: cut corners (on + N)
Examples: Students who cut corners are caught at the viva. | You cannot cut corners on laboratory safety.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; get/award/raise + a grade (Mỹ dùng cả làm động từ)
Examples: She needs a high grade to keep her scholarship. | The board awards grades from A to E.

Definition: ôn tập; sửa lại bản viết
Pattern: revise for + N (kì thi); revise + N (bản thảo)
Examples: He revised for the exam every evening. | She revised the introduction three times.

Pattern: cram for + N; nhân đôi phụ âm: cramming, crammed
Examples: Cramming the night before rarely raises a grade. | They crammed for the test during the lunch break.

Pattern: skip + N (a lesson, a chapter); nhân đôi phụ âm
Examples: He skipped two lessons and lost the thread. | Do not skip the chapter on method.

Pattern: expel + sb + from + N; thường ở dạng bị động
Examples: Two pupils were expelled from the school. | The college rarely expels a student for a first offence.

Pattern: suspend + sb + from + N; thường ở dạng bị động
Examples: He was suspended from classes for a week. | The university suspended three students pending an inquiry.

Pattern: invigilate + N hoặc invigilate at + N (Mỹ: proctor)
Examples: Two teachers invigilate every public exam. | She invigilated at the entrance test on Saturday.

Pattern: cite + N (a study, an author, a figure)
Examples: The essay cites fifteen peer-reviewed studies. | He cited the wrong edition of the book.

Definition: diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác
Pattern: paraphrase + N; cũng là danh từ đếm được
Examples: Paraphrase the source rather than quoting it in full. | A weak paraphrase keeps the original word order.

Pattern: summarise + N; dạng Mỹ viết summarize
Examples: Summarise the article in a hundred words. | She summarised the debate for the latecomers.

Pattern: annotate + N (a text, a diagram)
Examples: Annotate the passage before you answer. | He annotates every book he reads.

Definition: củng cố kiến thức đã học
Pattern: consolidate + N (learning, knowledge, gains)
Examples: A short quiz consolidates the morning's learning. | The holiday task consolidates work from the whole term.

Pattern: deliver + N (a lecture, a talk, a presentation)
Examples: She delivers the opening lecture every September. | He delivered a lecture on urban history.
